costNote: Steel, electronics and factory costs for locks, door hardware and access systems — $624M, about 53 cents per revenue dollar.

opex.name: Selling & administrative expenses
opex.note: One combined line in Allegion's statement — sales channels (builders, institutions, retailers) plus administration. It grew just 3% while revenue rose 9.6% — that's the margin story.

otherDetail.label: Other income, net
otherDetail.note: Includes a $4.1M gain on non-operating investments and $0.9M of interest on tariff refunds.

footerNote: Figures are rounded to whole $M from the release's decimal presentation; operating income was $284.6M as reported.

oneTimers.label: Tariff refunds — $19.9M
oneTimers.text: Q3 results include $19.9M of IEEPA tariff refunds in operating income (plus $0.9M of interest income) — money back from the US government that Allegion excludes from its adjusted figures. Without it, operating income still grew double digits.

segments.name: Americas
segments.note: Schlage, Von Duprin, LCN and more — up 11.7% (9.1% organic): non-residential (offices, schools, hospitals) grew low-double digits organically on volume and price; residential rose mid-single digits. Adjusted segment operating margin 30.1%.

segments.name: International
segments.note: Europe and Asia-Pacific brands (SimonsVoss, Interflex, CISA) — up 1.8% reported but down 0.2% organically as volumes fell; acquisitions/divestitures added 2.5 points. Adjusted margin 13.9%.

sources.label: Allegion Q3 2026 earnings release — SEC EDGAR Ex-99.1 (8-K, Oct 22, 2026)

takeaways.text: EPS rose 18.8% to $2.59 — and adjusted EPS was $2.60, so for once the GAAP and adjusted stories nearly match (the $19.9M tariff refund inside GAAP is excluded from adjusted).
takeaways.title: Clean double-digit growth

takeaways.text: The Americas segment runs at a 30.1% adjusted operating margin on institutional door hardware — pricing power plus volume leverage as non-residential construction demand holds up.
takeaways.title: Americas is a profit engine

takeaways.text: Full-year outlook raised: reported revenue growth of 9.5–10.5% and adjusted EPS of $9.05–$9.10, with available cash flow targeted at 85–95% of adjusted net income.
takeaways.title: Guidance raised

verdict: Textbook Allegion: Americas non-residential strength, a 24.3% operating margin, and a raised outlook.
